q: The wiretap channel (Wyner, 1975) achieves secure communication when the eavesdropper's channel is a degraded version of the legitimate receiver's channel. The secrecy capacity is:
exp: Secrecy capacity (Wyner): C_s = max_{p(x)}[I(X;Y) - I(X;Z)]⁺. If the eavesdropper's channel is noisier, we can achieve positive secrecy rate — perfect secrecy without a shared secret key, using only the channel's noise advantage.
